name: IDENTITY.md / USER.md
note: Who the agent is, who you are
summary: In OpenClaw's agent workspace, IDENTITY.md holds the agent's name, creature, vibe, emoji and avatar, and USER.md describes the person the agent works for and how to address them. IDENTITY.md is created during a first-run bootstrap ritual; USER.md is optional and loaded every session. Both are injected into the system prompt alongside SOUL.md and AGENTS.md.
facts: Name, Creature, Vibe, Emoji, Avatar (path, URL or data URI)
Injected into the system prompt's project context
goodFor: Personal assistants with a stable name and avatar
Telling the agent who you are once
watchOut: Workspace files are prompt-injection targets; restrict write access
